A + B means 'A is the mother of B'
A - B means 'A is the brother of B'
A x B means 'A is the wife of B'
A % B means 'A is the father of B'
A # B means 'A is the daughter of B'
Based on the above, how is T related to G if 'G # N # V + K # T'?
solution_text:
Given code definitions:
- A + B means 'A is the mother of B'
- A - B means 'A is the brother of B'
- A x B means 'A is the wife of B'
- A % B means 'A is the father of B'
- A # B means 'A is the daughter of B'
Expression: G # N # V + K # T
Decoding step-by-step:
1. G # N -> G is the daughter of N.
2. N # V -> N is the daughter of V.
3. V + K -> V is the mother of K.
4. K # T -> K is the daughter of T. Since V is already the mother of K, T must be the husband of V (and father of K and N).
Since N is the daughter of V and T, T is the father of N.
Since G is the daughter of N, T is G's mother's father.
Hence, option (B) is the correct answer.

- S -> 27 - 19 = 8

- T -> 27 - 20 = 7
- D -> 27 - 4 = 23

82 80 77 72 65 ?
solution_text:
Analyze the difference between consecutive numbers in the series:
- 82 − 80 = 2
- 80 − 77 = 3
- 77 − 72 = 5
- 72 − 65 = 7
Notice that the subtractions are consecutive prime numbers: 2, 3, 5, 7.
The next prime number after 7 is 11.
Therefore, the missing number is: 65 − 11 = 54.
Hence, option (C) is the correct answer.

3 Rectangles = 12 => Value of one rectangle = 12 / 3 = 4
3 Pentagons = 15 => Value of one pentagon = 15 / 3 = 5

question_text:
Seven people - H, I, J, K, L, M, and N - attend workshops on different days of the week starting from Monday
and ending on Sunday. K's workshop is on Wednesday.
Only one person attends between K and M. J attends workshop immediately after M. H attends on one of the
days before I but after N.
L attends the workshop before J but not on Monday.
On which day does H attend the workshop?
solution_text:
Seven people (H, I, J, K, L, M, N) attend workshops from Monday to Sunday:
1. 'K's workshop is on Wednesday' -> Wednesday = K.
2. 'Only one person attends between K and M' -> M could be Monday or Friday.
3. 'J attends workshop immediately after M' -> If M is Monday, J is Tuesday. If M is Friday, J is Saturday.
4. 'L attends the workshop before J but not on Monday' -> If M is Monday, J is Tuesday, which forces L to be on Monday (contradicting 'not on Monday'). Hence M cannot be on Monday. Therefore, M = Friday, and J = Saturday!
5. With J on Saturday, L attends before J (not on Monday), so L is on Tuesday.
6. 'H attends on one of the days before I but after N' -> Relative order: N < H < I. The open slots are Monday, Thursday, Sunday. Thus: Monday = N, Thursday = H, Sunday = I.

Complete Schedule:
- Monday: N
- Tuesday: L
- Wednesday: K
- Thursday: H
- Friday: M
- Saturday: J
- Sunday: I

Question: On which day does H attend the workshop?
- H attends on Thursday.
Hence, option (D) is the correct answer.

Sunday of the same week. S has flight on third last day of the week. Only two people have flight between R
and S. Only four people have flight between R and Q. P has flight immediately after N. M doesn't have flight
on Monday. On which day does M have a flight?
solution_text:
Seven persons (M, N, O, P, Q, R, S) have flights from Monday to Sunday:
1. 'S has flight on third last day of the week' -> Sunday is last, Saturday is 2nd last, Friday is 3rd last. So Friday = S.
2. 'Only two people have flight between R and S' -> Two days before Friday are Thursday and Wednesday. So Tuesday = R.
3. 'Only four people have flight between R and Q' -> R is Tuesday. Four days after Tuesday are Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. So Sunday = Q.
4. 'P has flight immediately after N' -> Consecutive pair (N, P). Available open slots are Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday. The only adjacent open days are Wednesday and Thursday: Wednesday = N, Thursday = P.
5. Remaining days are Monday and Saturday. 'M doesn't have flight on Monday' -> Saturday = M, Monday = O.

Complete Schedule:
- Monday: O
- Tuesday: R
- Wednesday: N
- Thursday: P
- Friday: S
- Saturday: M
- Sunday: Q

question_text: Each of seven people, E, F, G, H, J, K and L, has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. 7. Number of people with exams before L (Wednesday) = Monday and Tuesday = 2 people (G and K).
Hence, the correct option is D (Two).

8 triangle are formed.
Number of triangle formed from four different squares
= 8+8+8+8 = 32
Number of triangles formed from joining two squares =
2+2+2 = 6
The number of triangles formed by dividing a triangle
in to two parts is 3.
Number of triangles = 3 + 3 = 6
Total number of triangles = 32 + 6 + 6 = 44

solution_text:
A structure formed by squares. Big squares
are divided in four small squares. Each small square
contains Six squares.
So, square formed by each four squares = 6 + 6 + 6 + 6
= 24
Four small squares made 6 new square.
Hence, total number of squares = 24 + 6
= 30

solution_text:
According to the rule of cube, if two depicted
faces of two cubes are same, then the third faces will be
opposite to each other. The first and third cube have two
same faces, hence third faces of them will be opposite
to each other. Hence opposite face of Black will be
Orange.

solution_text:
In both the above cases 3 is the common
number so clockwise rotation of 3 gives equidistant
surface and then face of the dice which is absent is
opposite to the common face.
3 6 4 First dice
3 5 Second dice
It is clear that the opposite face of 3 will be 2 and the
opposite face of 5 will be 4.

  <text x="55" y="105" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#334155">2. Rule: If two faces are common, the remaining third faces</text>
  <text x="70" y="125" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#0369a1">are strictly opposite to each other.</text>
  <text x="55" y="155" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#334155">3. Face 2 is strictly opposite to Face 5.</text>

</svg>
